handling_rule: Items with lithium batteries are collected by surface transport only. A swollen, overheating or smoking battery is a product-safety report, never a routine return.
Cookware and appliances must be cleaned and dry before pickup. Knives and blades are returned in a blade guard or the original sheath.
Items must be unworn and unwashed with the tags attached. Innerwear and swimwear are returnable only if defective.
The seal must be intact. Aerosols, perfume and nail polish are flammable and are collected by surface transport only.
Helmets and other protective gear are not accepted back once used. Gas canisters and camping fuel are non-returnable.
Toys with button cells are packed so the battery compartment is taped shut. A small part that comes loose is a product-safety report.
Perishable and chilled items are never collected. A damaged, expired or wrong item is refunded on a photo, without a return.
An assembled item counts as opened. Pickup needs two handlers and is booked at least 48 hours ahead.
